headline: Evidence Over Hype
thesis: From Educause's No. 1 priority to a Maryland trial and an EdReports brief, the message this week is that AI must prove its value before it scales.
summary: Higher ed and K-12 leaders are converging on one question: where does AI add real value? Educause's 2027 Top 10 ranks it first, a University of Maryland trial found only about 15% of students used its AI study assistant, and EdReports found little third-party evidence behind vendors' AI features. Meanwhile tech sovereignty, AI policy guidance, and Ed-Fi's statewide data stories show institutions seeking control of their stacks and data. Coverage dated today was thin; several sources are represented by their most recent items.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · OCTOBER 26, 2026 · Search-snippet based; several sources had no items dated today and show recent or evergreen content.
